ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to 25% high-intensity (white/light-grey) across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large irregular contiguous white blob extending from the tip toward the mid-section. The right lobe contains a smaller, more fragmented white region confined to the outer terminal corner. The central peduncle junction and interior lobe regions are solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 72 degrees; vertex is sharp and clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits approximately 9 primary jagged peaks. The right lobe exhibits approximately 11 more tightly packed peaks. A distinct deep secondary notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge shows a strong concave curve leading into the median notch and a convex curve at the distal terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters are present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, suggesting localized surface colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several near-horizontal dark linear streaks are visible traversing the white pigmentation patch on the distal half of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white scarring/depigmentation at both fluke tips; a significant traumatic indentation (nick) is located on the trailing edge of the right lobe mid-way between the notch and the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'marbled' pattern within the white patch of the left lobe featuring several small isolated dark islands of pixels.
